# exo_mailbox_auto_reply_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `auto_decline_future_requests_when_oof` (Boolean) Maps to the -AutoDeclineFutureRequestsWhenOOF parameter.
- `auto_reply_state` (String) Maps to the -AutoReplyState parameter.
- `create_oof_event` (Boolean) Maps to the -CreateOOFEvent parameter.
- `decline_all_events_for_scheduled_oof` (Boolean) Maps to the -DeclineAllEventsForScheduledOOF parameter.
- `decline_events_for_scheduled_oof` (Boolean) Maps to the -DeclineEventsForScheduledOOF parameter.
- `decline_meeting_message` (String) Maps to the -DeclineMeetingMessage parameter.
- `end_time` (String) Maps to the -EndTime parameter.
- `events_to_delete_i_ds` (Set of String) Maps to the -EventsToDeleteIDs parameter.
- `external_audience` (String) Maps to the -ExternalAudience parameter.
- `external_message` (String) Maps to the -ExternalMessage parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `internal_message` (String) Maps to the -InternalMessage parameter.
- `oof_event_subject` (String) Maps to the -OOFEventSubject parameter.
- `start_time` (String) Maps to the -StartTime parameter.
